reasons.police_report_adequate: It is filed two days after the stated loss and gives a location, but omits the loss date and has only two short lines, so it is weak support.
reasons.claim_status: Request the full unattended-vehicle clause, a dated police narrative, and ownership/value evidence; the back-seat witness account conflicts with the claimant's boot account.
reasons.evidence_reliability: The serial number, police record, and damaged-lock photo offer some support, but the undated photo, sparse report, missing receipt, and conflicting witness account keep reliability low.
